# Twitch rewards, chat, moderation and clips

C# methods for a **Run C# code** step. See [C# methods](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run C# code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-csharp-step.png)

## TwitchGetRewards

Lists every channel point reward of your channel, with title, cost, prompt, colour and whether it is on or paused. IsOurs tells you if Cuebot created it (only those can be changed).

```csharp
List<TwitchReward> TwitchGetRewards()
```

**Gives back:** A list of rewards. Empty when Twitch said no (a warning goes to the log).

**Example**

```csharp
var rewards = CPH.TwitchGetRewards();
CPH.LogInfo($"You have {rewards.Count} rewards");
```

## EnableReward

Turns a channel point reward on, so viewers can see it. rewardId is the reward's id or title; empty means the reward that ran this action. Only works for rewards Cuebot created.

```csharp
void EnableReward(string rewardId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.EnableReward("Hydrate");
```

## DisableReward

Turns a channel point reward off, so viewers no longer see it. rewardId is the reward's id or title; empty means the reward that ran this action. Only works for rewards Cuebot created.

```csharp
void DisableReward(string rewardId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DisableReward("Hydrate");
```

## PauseReward

Pauses a channel point reward. Viewers still see it but cannot redeem it. rewardId is the reward's id or title; empty means the reward that ran this action. Only works for rewards Cuebot created.

```csharp
void PauseReward(string rewardId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.PauseReward("Hydrate");
```

## UnPauseReward

Unpauses a channel point reward, so viewers can redeem it again. rewardId is the reward's id or title; empty means the reward that ran this action. Only works for rewards Cuebot created.

```csharp
void UnPauseReward(string rewardId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.UnPauseReward("Hydrate");
```

## UpdateRewardMaxPerStream

Sets how many times a reward can be redeemed in one stream, by everyone together. 0 means no limit. With additive true, it adds to the current limit. Only works for rewards Cuebot created.

```csharp
void UpdateRewardMaxPerStream(string rewardId, long redeems, bool additive = false)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.UpdateRewardMaxPerStream("Hydrate", 20);
```

## UpdateRewardMaxPerUserPerStream

Sets how many times each viewer can redeem a reward in one stream. 0 means no limit. With additive true, it adds to the current limit. Only works for rewards Cuebot created.

```csharp
void UpdateRewardMaxPerUserPerStream(string rewardId, long redeems, bool additive = false)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.UpdateRewardMaxPerUserPerStream("Hydrate", 3);
```

## TwitchRedemptionFulfill

Marks a viewer's redemption as done, so it leaves the reward queue. You need both the reward id and the redemption id (the %rewardId% and %redemptionId% of a reward trigger).

```csharp
bool TwitchRedemptionFulfill(string rewardId, string redemptionId)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. False when an id is empty or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchRedemptionFulfill(args["rewardId"].ToString(), args["redemptionId"].ToString());
CPH.LogInfo($"Fulfilled: {ok}");
```

## TwitchRedemptionCancel

Cancels a viewer's redemption and gives them their channel points back. You need both the reward id and the redemption id.

```csharp
bool TwitchRedemptionCancel(string rewardId, string redemptionId)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. False when an id is empty or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchRedemptionCancel(args["rewardId"].ToString(), args["redemptionId"].ToString());
CPH.LogInfo($"Refunded: {ok}");
```

## TwitchGetRewardCounter

Reads how many times a reward has been redeemed, as Cuebot counts it. rewardId is the reward's id or title; empty means the reward that ran this action. Resetting on go-live is set per reward on the Twitch page, so persisted is ignored.

```csharp
TwitchRewardCounter? TwitchGetRewardCounter(string rewardId, bool persisted = true)
```

**Gives back:** The counter (Count is the number), or null when the reward was not found.

**Example**

```csharp
var counter = CPH.TwitchGetRewardCounter("Hydrate");
CPH.LogInfo($"Hydrate used {counter?.Count} times");
```

## TwitchGetRewardUserCounter

Reads how many times one viewer (by login name) has redeemed a reward. persisted is ignored.

```csharp
TwitchRewardCounter? TwitchGetRewardUserCounter(string userLogin, string rewardId, bool persisted = true)
```

**Gives back:** The counter (Count is the number), or null when the reward or viewer was not found.

**Example**

```csharp
var counter = CPH.TwitchGetRewardUserCounter("coolviewer", "Hydrate");
CPH.LogInfo($"coolviewer used it {counter?.Count} times");
```

## TwitchGetRewardUserCounterById

Reads how many times one viewer (by Twitch user id) has redeemed a reward. persisted is ignored.

```csharp
TwitchRewardCounter? TwitchGetRewardUserCounterById(string userId, string rewardId, bool persisted = true)
```

**Gives back:** The counter (Count is the number), or null when the id is empty or the reward or viewer was not found.

**Example**

```csharp
var counter = CPH.TwitchGetRewardUserCounterById("12345678", "Hydrate");
CPH.LogInfo($"Used {counter?.Count} times");
```

## TwitchGetRewardUserCounters

Lists every viewer's redemption count for one reward. Handy for a "top redeemers" message. persisted is ignored.

```csharp
List<TwitchRewardCounter> TwitchGetRewardUserCounters(string rewardId, bool persisted = true)
```

**Gives back:** A list with one counter per viewer (user id, name and count). Empty when the reward was not found.

**Example**

```csharp
var counters = CPH.TwitchGetRewardUserCounters("Hydrate");
var top = counters.OrderByDescending(c => c.Count).FirstOrDefault();
CPH.LogInfo($"Top: {top?.UserName} with {top?.Count}");
```

## TwitchResetRewardCounter

Sets a reward's total redemption count back to 0. rewardId is the reward's id or title; empty means the reward that ran this action.

```csharp
void TwitchResetRewardCounter(string rewardId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.TwitchResetRewardCounter("Hydrate");
```

## TwitchResetRewardUserCounters

Clears every viewer's redemption count for one reward. rewardId is the reward's id or title; empty means the reward that ran this action.

```csharp
void TwitchResetRewardUserCounters(string rewardId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.TwitchResetRewardUserCounters("Hydrate");
```

## TwitchResetUserRewardCounter

Clears one viewer's (by Twitch user id) redemption count for one reward.

```csharp
void TwitchResetUserRewardCounter(string rewardId, string userId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.TwitchResetUserRewardCounter("Hydrate", "12345678");
```

## TwitchResetUserRewardCounters

Clears one viewer's (by Twitch user id) redemption counts for every reward. persisted is ignored, but you must still pass it.

```csharp
void TwitchResetUserRewardCounters(string userId, bool persisted)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.TwitchResetUserRewardCounters("12345678", true);
```

## TwitchReplyToMessage

Replies to one chat message, so it shows as a reply. replyId is the message's id (%messageId%). useBot sends with your bot; fallback uses your main account when the bot is not signed in.

```csharp
bool TwitchReplyToMessage(string message, string replyId, bool useBot = true, bool fallback = true)
```

**Gives back:** true when Twitch accepted it. False when the message is empty or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchReplyToMessage("Good question!", args["messageId"].ToString());
CPH.LogInfo($"Replied: {ok}");
```

## TwitchDeleteChatMessage

Deletes one chat message by its id. Your main account deletes it; bot is ignored.

```csharp
bool TwitchDeleteChatMessage(string messageId, bool bot = true)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. False when the id is empty or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchDeleteChatMessage(args["messageId"].ToString());
CPH.LogInfo($"Deleted: {ok}");
```

## TwitchClearChatMessages

Clears your whole Twitch chat. Your main account does it; bot is ignored.

```csharp
bool TwitchClearChatMessages(bool bot = true)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. When Twitch refuses or is not signed in, it gives back false and writes a warning to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchClearChatMessages();
CPH.LogInfo($"Chat cleared: {ok}");
```

## TwitchPinChatMessage

Pins a chat message (by its id) at the top of chat. duration is in seconds (30 to 1800); 0 keeps it pinned until the stream ends. bot is ignored.

```csharp
bool TwitchPinChatMessage(string messageId, int duration = 0, bool bot = false)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. False when the id is empty or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchPinChatMessage(args["messageId"].ToString(), 120);
CPH.LogInfo($"Pinned: {ok}");
```

## TwitchSendAndPinMessage

Sends a message from your main account and pins it right away. duration works like TwitchPinChatMessage (0 keeps it until the stream ends). bot is ignored.

```csharp
bool TwitchSendAndPinMessage(string message, int duration = 0, bool bot = false)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. False when the message is empty or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchSendAndPinMessage("Giveaway: type !join to enter!", 300);
CPH.LogInfo($"Sent and pinned: {ok}");
```

## TwitchUnpinMessage

Unpins the chat message that is pinned now.

```csharp
bool TwitchUnpinMessage()
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. False when nothing is pinned or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchUnpinMessage();
CPH.LogInfo($"Unpinned: {ok}");
```

## TwitchUpdatePinnedMessageDuration

Changes how long the pinned message stays, counted from now, in seconds. 0 keeps it pinned until the stream ends.

```csharp
bool TwitchUpdatePinnedMessageDuration(int duration)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. False when nothing is pinned or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchUpdatePinnedMessageDuration(600);
CPH.LogInfo($"Pin time changed: {ok}");
```

## TwitchGetPinnedMessage

Reads the chat message that is pinned now: its text, who wrote it, who pinned it, and when the pin started and ends.

```csharp
TwitchPinnedMessage? TwitchGetPinnedMessage()
```

**Gives back:** The pinned message, or null when nothing is pinned or the check failed.

**Example**

```csharp
var pin = CPH.TwitchGetPinnedMessage();
CPH.LogInfo(pin == null ? "Nothing pinned" : $"Pinned: {pin.Message}");
```

## TwitchWarnUser

Sends a viewer (by login name) a Twitch warning with your reason. They must accept it before they can chat again. useBot is ignored.

```csharp
bool TwitchWarnUser(string userName, string reason, bool useBot = false)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. False when the name is empty or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchWarnUser("rudeviewer", "Please keep chat friendly.");
CPH.LogInfo($"Warned: {ok}");
```

## TwitchAddActiveMonitoringSuspiciousStatus

Puts a viewer (by Twitch user id) under active monitoring. Their messages get flagged for your moderators.

```csharp
bool TwitchAddActiveMonitoringSuspiciousStatus(string userId)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. False when the id is empty or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchAddActiveMonitoringSuspiciousStatus("12345678");
CPH.LogInfo($"Monitoring: {ok}");
```

## TwitchAddRestrictedSuspiciousStatus

Restricts a viewer (by Twitch user id). Their messages are kept out of chat; only moderators see them.

```csharp
bool TwitchAddRestrictedSuspiciousStatus(string userId)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. False when the id is empty or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchAddRestrictedSuspiciousStatus("12345678");
CPH.LogInfo($"Restricted: {ok}");
```

## TwitchRemoveSuspiciousStatus

Removes the monitored or restricted status from a viewer (by Twitch user id).

```csharp
bool TwitchRemoveSuspiciousStatus(string userId)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. False when the id is empty or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchRemoveSuspiciousStatus("12345678");
CPH.LogInfo($"Status removed: {ok}");
```

## TwitchAddBlockedTerm

Adds a word or phrase to your channel's blocked terms. Messages with it are kept out of chat.

```csharp
bool TwitchAddBlockedTerm(string term)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. False when the term is empty or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchAddBlockedTerm("spoiler");
CPH.LogInfo($"Term blocked: {ok}");
```

## TwitchRemoveBlockedTerm

Removes a word or phrase from your blocked terms. Type it as it was added; upper and lower case do not matter.

```csharp
bool TwitchRemoveBlockedTerm(string term)
```

**Gives back:** true when it was removed. False when your channel has no such term, the term is empty, or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchRemoveBlockedTerm("spoiler");
CPH.LogInfo($"Term removed: {ok}");
```

## TwitchGetBlockedTerms

Lists every blocked word or phrase of your channel.

```csharp
List<string> TwitchGetBlockedTerms()
```

**Gives back:** A list of texts. Empty when Twitch said no (a warning goes to the log).

**Example**

```csharp
var terms = CPH.TwitchGetBlockedTerms();
CPH.LogInfo($"Blocked: {string.Join(", ", terms)}");
```

## TwitchApproveAutoHeldMessage

Lets a message through that AutoMod held back for review. Pass the held message's id.

```csharp
bool TwitchApproveAutoHeldMessage(string messageId)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. False when the id is empty or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchApproveAutoHeldMessage(args["messageId"].ToString());
CPH.LogInfo($"Approved: {ok}");
```

## TwitchDenyAutoHeldMessage

Blocks a message that AutoMod held back for review, so it never shows in chat.

```csharp
bool TwitchDenyAutoHeldMessage(string messageId)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. False when the id is empty or Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchDenyAutoHeldMessage(args["messageId"].ToString());
CPH.LogInfo($"Denied: {ok}");
```

Lists every moderator of your channel, with their id, login name and display name.

Lists every VIP of your channel, with their id, login name and display name.

```csharp
List<TwitchUserInfo> TwitchGetVips()
```

**Gives back:** A list of users. Empty when Twitch said no (a warning goes to the log).

Lists the cheermotes (Bits emotes like Cheer100) your channel can use, with their tiers, colours and image links.


## TwitchBlockUser

Blocks someone for your Twitch account, so they cannot whisper you or show up in your chat. userLogin is their login name. The context and reason are not sent to Twitch. Needs the "Block and unblock users" permission on the Twitch Settings tab (sign in again after ticking it).

```csharp
bool TwitchBlockUser(string userLogin, TwitchBlockContext context = TwitchBlockContext.None, TwitchBlockReason reason = TwitchBlockReason.None)
```

**Gives back:** true when Twitch blocked them; false otherwise (a warning goes to the log).

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchBlockUser("spammer123");
CPH.LogInfo($"Blocked: {ok}");
```

## TwitchBlockUserById

Like TwitchBlockUser, with the person's Twitch user id. Needs the "Block and unblock users" permission on the Twitch Settings tab (sign in again after ticking it).

```csharp
bool TwitchBlockUserById(string userId, TwitchBlockContext context = TwitchBlockContext.None, TwitchBlockReason reason = TwitchBlockReason.None)
```

**Gives back:** true when Twitch blocked them; false otherwise (a warning goes to the log).

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchBlockUserById("12345678");
CPH.LogInfo($"Blocked: {ok}");
```

## TwitchUnblockUser

Unblocks someone you blocked before. userLogin is their login name. Needs the "Block and unblock users" permission on the Twitch Settings tab (sign in again after ticking it).

```csharp
bool TwitchUnblockUser(string userLogin)
```

**Gives back:** true when Twitch unblocked them; false otherwise (a warning goes to the log).

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchUnblockUser("coolviewer");
CPH.LogInfo($"Unblocked: {ok}");
```

## TwitchUnblockUserById

Like TwitchUnblockUser, with the person's Twitch user id. Needs the "Block and unblock users" permission on the Twitch Settings tab (sign in again after ticking it).

```csharp
bool TwitchUnblockUserById(string userId)
```

**Gives back:** true when Twitch unblocked them; false otherwise (a warning goes to the log).

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.TwitchUnblockUserById("12345678");
CPH.LogInfo($"Unblocked: {ok}");
```

## GetAllClips

Lists the clips of your own channel. Clips come most viewed first, at most 1000. isFeatured true gives only featured clips, false only the others, and leaving it out gives both.

```csharp
List<ClipData> GetAllClips(bool? isFeatured = null)
```

**Gives back:** A list of clips (link, title, views, creator and more). Empty when Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
var clips = CPH.GetAllClips();
CPH.LogInfo($"You have {clips.Count} clips");
```

## GetClips

Lists your own channel's most viewed clips, up to count clips (at least 1). isFeatured true gives only featured clips, false only the others.

```csharp
List<ClipData> GetClips(int count, bool? isFeatured = null)
```

**Gives back:** A list of clips. Empty when Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
var clips = CPH.GetClips(5);
CPH.LogInfo($"Top clip: {clips.FirstOrDefault()?.Url}");
```

## GetClipsForGame

Lists clips of one game or category from all of Twitch, using the game's Twitch id. Other versions add how many clips, a start and end time, or a time span back from now (like the last 7 days).

```csharp
List<ClipData> GetClipsForGame(int gameId, bool? isFeatured = null)
List<ClipData> GetClipsForGame(int gameId, int count, bool? isFeatured = null)
List<ClipData> GetClipsForGame(int gameId, DateTime start, DateTime end, bool? isFeatured = null)
List<ClipData> GetClipsForGame(int gameId, DateTime start, DateTime end, int count, bool? isFeatured = null)
List<ClipData> GetClipsForGame(int gameId, TimeSpan duration, bool? isFeatured = null)
List<ClipData> GetClipsForGame(int gameId, TimeSpan duration, int count, bool? isFeatured = null)
```

**Gives back:** A list of clips, most viewed first. Empty when Twitch said no.

**Example**

```csharp
var clips = CPH.GetClipsForGame(509658, TimeSpan.FromDays(7), 5);
CPH.LogInfo($"Top clip this week: {clips.FirstOrDefault()?.Title}");
```

Lists clips of another channel, by login name or by user id as a number. Other versions add how many clips, a start and end time, or a time span back from now. Great for a shoutout that plays a clip.

```csharp

List<ClipData> GetClipsForUser(string username, DateTime start, DateTime end, int count, bool? isFeatured = null)

List<ClipData> GetClipsForUser(int userId, bool? isFeatured = null)

List<ClipData> GetClipsForUser(int userId, DateTime start, DateTime end, bool? isFeatured = null)
List<ClipData> GetClipsForUser(int userId, DateTime start, DateTime end, int count, bool? isFeatured = null)
List<ClipData> GetClipsForUser(int userId, TimeSpan duration, bool? isFeatured = null)
```
